Your mission

Welcome to your new opportunity with Sungrow!

As an EV Field Service Engineer, you will play a crucial role in supporting our customers and ensuring the reliable operation of Sungrow EV charging solutions across the UK. You will be a trusted technical partner, delivering remote and on-site support while helping customers get the most from our products.

This is an exciting opportunity to become one of our early EV engineering specialists in the UK. You will have significant scope for career growth, including the potential to help build and lead a local EV engineering team in the future.

Please note that this role involves up to 60% travel, with approximately three days per week spent on customer sites.

Your ResponsibilitiesCustomer Service

Device Monitoring & Remote Diagnostics

  • Proactively monitor commissioned EV chargers remotely to identify potential issues.
  • Diagnose and resolve charger malfunctions, communication issues, and electrical, electronic, or control-system faults.
  • Troubleshoot communication with local inverters, energy meters, onboard controllers, and customer SCADA systems.
  • Clearly explain issues and resolutions to customers, building confidence in Sungrow products.
  • Implement proactive actions—including remote reboots, configuration changes, and firmware updates—to maximise fleet availability and minimise downtime.

Commissioning & Field Troubleshooting

  • Align commissioning activities for new EV chargers with customer requirements.
  • Provide clear remote guidance and support for commissioning tasks.
  • Plan and coordinate on-site commissioning with installers, electricians, platform technicians, and other stakeholders.
  • Integrate EV chargers into customer systems, including local grids, EMS controllers, OCPP backends, and shared-meter arrangements.
  • Configure systems to ensure safe, reliable, and seamless operation.
  • Lead on-site troubleshooting for complex technical issues and replace faulty components in compliance with electrical safety regulations.

Specialised Tool Expertise

  • Develop strong expertise in Sungrow monitoring and diagnostic tools.
  • Use these tools to identify potential issues early and support proactive maintenance.
Product Improvement & Data Management

Quality Issue Reporting

  • Identify and document recurring quality issues for Product, R&D, and Manufacturing teams.
  • Contribute practical field insights that support continuous product improvement.

Database Management

  • Maintain accurate customer, service, and issue records in internal systems.

Data Processing Enhancement

  • Support improvements to internal data-processing methods and platforms to strengthen performance evaluation and fault detection.


Your profile

  • Hands-on experience in an electrotechnical or electrical engineering field, with strong practical troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • A genuine interest in green technology and EV charging infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking and experience using command-line tools to diagnose network issues.
  • Experience with OCPP and Modbus-TCP communication protocols is highly desirable.
  • Ability to interpret electrical single-line diagrams to diagnose system performance and faults.
  • Technical proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or professional statistical-analysis software; Linux knowledge is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to support non-technical customers in troubleshooting situations.
  • English proficiency at B2 level or above is required. Additional European languages are advantageous.
  • Must be based in the United Kingdom and able to travel extensively across the country, with occasional international travel for training or troubleshooting.
  • Existing right to work in the UK is required; visa sponsorship or relocation may be considered for exceptional candidates.

title: Product Lead
description:
Product Lead

Location: Ireland / UK - Remote first

Type: Full-time, permanent


About Kota

Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products, Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution, we're making benefits more accessible, valued and global.

Today we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio and OpenAI.


The Role

We're hiring a Product Lead to own a product area at Kota. You'll set the vision and strategy, make the calls on what gets built, and lead the engineers who build it. Product Leads managing their own engineers is unusual and it's deliberate: one person accountable for the product and the team shipping it.


You'll start in Insurances, which powers how employers offer and manage group cover: health, dental, vision, critical illness, life and income protection. It's our most complex area, and the work is turning underwriting and compliance rules into flows an employee can finish in minutes.


That won't be the whole of it. Our teams are loosely split between Insurances and Core/Finance, and people work across the problem set. As we add products and move into new countries the areas will change, so we want someone adaptable and opportunistic who'll own whichever part matters most as we grow. The remit is broad with little structure around it, so it suits a high ownership drive.


What You'll Do

  • Own the vision and strategy for your area, and make the product calls on what gets built

  • Lead and grow a group of product engineers, coaching them on scope and delivery decisions rather than assigning tickets

  • Shape and lead 6-week Shape Up cycles for new features and provider integrations

  • Simplify insurer onboarding, plan setup, premium management and benefit workflows

  • Translate compliance and underwriting complexity into flows people complete

  • Work across the whole business. Support, success, sales and operations all have a stake in what you own

  • Help shape what the product areas become as we add products and enter new markets

  • Ship fast at a high quality bar, and hold the team to it

What We're Looking For

  • Product experience at lead, staff or principal level. Strong senior candidates are in scope if the rest lines up

  • An entrepreneurial streak. You've founded something, worked at an early-stage startup, or spent time in engineering before moving into product

  • You've owned the vision and strategy for an area, not just executed against someone else's

  • Comfortable with fluid scope. You've picked up an unfamiliar domain before and become useful quickly

  • Genuine cross-business collaboration. You've worked with support, success and sales, not only with engineers and designers with the occasional customer call

  • You come from an environment with a high quality bar. It usually shows in the product itself

  • Clear, concise communication, spoken and written, focused on value and outcomes rather than process

  • Scale-up experience, roughly Series A to D. Seed-stage experience on top of that is a plus

  • Comfortable managing people, or ready to start

  • Domain experience. Fintech or Insurtech is the closest match to what you'll work on, then HR tech, benefits, employee expenses or travel. Anything sold to an employer that employees then use. The business model matters more than the industry label: if you've had to serve both an HR buyer and the employees using the product, that's the experience we care about


Not every box needs ticking. We'd rather see someone strong on several of these and light on others than someone who technically matches everything.

Our Values

  • Have Integrity. We care deeply about our why and it won't jeopardise our how.

  • Care Deeply. Our products are our story, we look at the details, go the extra mile to delight customers.

  • Own Your Ship. Ask why, do the work, get the data, solve the problem, be an owner.

  • Raise the Bar. We continuously look to push past good enough. Expect more, move faster, and never stop raising your and the team's standards.

  • Play to Win. We exist because we decided to say no to the norm, now we do this every day.

Kota Benefits

  • Health Insurance via Kota

  • Workplace Pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota (country dependent)

  • WFH stipend to support your home office needs

  • Generous paid time off, work hard and take the time you need

  • Annual company-wide offsite and dedicated team offsite

Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things simple and respectful of your time.

  • Screening call (30 mins) with our talent team: your background, what you're looking for, and the practicalities

  • Competency interview (60 mins) with one of our Product Leads, covering how you work, what you've owned and how you make product calls

  • Task session (60 mins) with our GM and one other, working through a real Insurances problem together

  • Call with founders (30 mins) with our CEO and CTO: our vision, and your thoughts on it

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer — TypeScript / Next.js (100%, m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

You are the architect and builder of the customer-facing side of the LEASETEQ platform in Berlin, and the owner of our German market on it. You design the digital application journey and the portals that carry real customers, dealers and operations teams at production scale, and you make sure German credit rules, compliance requirements and dealer flows are represented correctly in a platform that also serves Switzerland and Austria. You work in a small, senior team where your decisions have direct product impact, and you naturally bring AI tooling into your daily engineering workflow without being asked.

What you will do

  • Own the German market on our customer-facing platform: credit and compliance requirements, dealer flows, German copy, and the acceptance criteria that make them verifiable
  • Design and build the digital application journey — multi-step forms, validation, resumable state, document upload, KYC steps and the unhappy paths users actually hit
  • Build and maintain the customer, dealer and operations portals, including the operations board and the logic that decides where a case belongs
  • Write the use-case and API layers behind the journey to our clean-architecture standard — this is a full-stack role, not a UI role
  • Own field-level mapping into the CRM and the Flowable-based process engine — beneficial ownership, source of funds, origin of income, additional persons — where a wrong key is a compliance defect, not a cosmetic one
  • Author specification-driven change proposals, and act as the named human approver for journey and mapping changes in the German market
  • Grow end-to-end test coverage on the critical journeys: coverage is what licenses autonomous agent work in a module
  • Work with our Berlin backend team on the seam between the orchestration core and the customer-facing platform, and with our Jakarta platform engineers who own the journey across all three markets
  • Communicate clearly in German and English with engineering peers and business stakeholders


Your profile

  • 6+ years of full-stack TypeScript engineering, with recent production work in React and Next.js App Router — server components, server actions and route handlers, with a clear grasp of what runs where — is mandatory
  • Fintech experience is mandatory: production work on a regulated financial product — leasing, lending, banking, payments or insurance — where money moved and a regulator could ask why
  • Proven ownership of a complex multi-step onboarding or application flow is mandatory: validation strategy, partial persistence and resumption, conditional branching by market or product, document upload
  • Real backend capability: use cases, repository implementations, API handlers and PostgreSQL / Prisma queries — roughly a 60/40 split toward the frontend, not 90/10
  • State and data-fetching maturity (Zustand or equivalent, TanStack Query) and confident use of form and schema tooling (Formik or React Hook Form with Zod), including server-side validation parity
  • End-to-end testing with Playwright or Cypress on flows that are slow, stateful and integration-dependent
  • AI-first engineering mindset: daily use of coding assistants and agents on production work, and the ability to write a change specification precise enough that an agent implements it correctly and a reviewer can verify that it did
  • Working understanding of the German regulatory environment for consumer credit or asset finance — BaFin-supervised context, AML/KYC obligations, consumer-credit disclosure — is a strong plus
  • Internationalisation as a habit — no hard-coded strings, and awareness of what four locales do to layout and copy
  • Fluent German and English


Why us?

  • Founding-team-level ownership of our customer-facing platform and of the German market on it
  • Direct collaboration with the CTO and the founders, including regular visits to our Swiss headquarters
  • A genuinely AI-first process, not a slogan: specification-driven delivery where agents execute approved changes and humans own scope, architecture, regulatory and release decisions
  • Hybrid setup with 2-3 days per week in our coworking office in Berlin (WeWork, Stresemannstrasse)
  • Competitive and fair salary: €70,000 - €90,000 gross per year, depending on experience and impact
  • 10–15% annual bonus tied to company performance and clear OKRs
  • Tax-free monthly benefit allowance of €50 that you can use for what you personally value
  • Sustainable mobility budget: subsidy for e-bike leasing and app-based car sharing for occasional trips
  • Additional health insurance options, including enhanced coverage for dental and vision care
  • Company-supported pension scheme with employer contributions on top of the statutory system
  • Employer-funded disability coverage starting from day one of employment
  • Dedicated AI tooling budget (e.g. Cursor, Claude API) so you can experiment and move fast
  • Modern Apple devices
  • Our remote policy promises 4 weeks & worldwide
About LEASETEQ
LEASETEQ builds the orchestration brain for mid-market car leasing and asset finance in the DACH region. Our platform automates the full contract lifecycle – from origination and credit decision through to end-of-term – using Flowable BPM as the core process engine on a modern, event-driven micro-services architecture, with a Next.js / TypeScript platform serving our customer, dealer and operations portals in four languages across Switzerland, Germany and Austria.
We are an AI-first engineering team: agents, intelligent workflows and LLM-augmented automation are how we build today, not items on a future roadmap. From our base in Switzerland, our subsidiaries in Austria and Germany and our engineering team in Jakarta, you join a small, senior team where your decisions have visible impact on customers, partners and the future of our product.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python & TypeScript, Microservices & Data Pipelines)
description:
EquiMatch is an AI-powered M&A origination platform connecting private equity firms, search funds, corporate development teams, and M&A advisors with acquisition targets. Behind the product is a data-heavy platform: web crawlers, LLM-driven company analyzers, scoring pipelines, a unified mailbox service, and CRM integrations — orchestrated across dozens of Python and Node.js microservices.
We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is strong in Python, solid in TypeScript, and used to owning distributed systems in production. You’ll split your time between Python services and pipelines and TypeScript services built on Encore, and you’ll be expected to set technical direction, not just execute on it. We value engineers who use AI daily to move faster and build better.

Tasks

  • Design, build, and operate Python and Node.js (TypeScript/Encore) microservices: define service boundaries, APIs, data flows, and integrations.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines — crawling, enrichment, company analysis, scoring — orchestrated with Prefect.
  • Model data and optimize queries on PostgreSQL (schema design, migrations, indexing, query performance).
  • Work with asynchronous messaging (NSQ) and background job queues to build resilient, idempotent processing.
  • Integrate LLM APIs into production workflows (extraction, classification, summarization) and make them reliable, observable, and cost-efficient.
  • Own features end-to-end: requirements, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment on Railway, and monitoring.
  • Improve observability and performance across services and LLM calls: tracing, metrics, slow-query analysis, failure-rate monitoring.
  • Drive architecture decisions, write technical designs, and mentor other engineers through reviews and pairing.
  • Contribute to automation (n8n) and internal tooling where needed.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of professional backend experience, with at least 4 years of Python in production.
  • 2+ years of professional TypeScript/Node.js experience building backend services (Encore, NestJS, Fastify, Express, or similar).
  • Deep experience with modern Python tooling: async/await, type hints, FastAPI or similar, Pydantic, pytest.
  • Strong command of microservice architecture: service decomposition, API design, resiliency, idempotency, observability.
  • Production experience with PostgreSQL — schema design, migrations, query optimization.
  • Experience with message queues or workflow orchestration (Prefect, Celery, NSQ, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar).
  • Track record of owning systems end-to-end in production, including incidents and performance work.
  • Habitual use of AI tools in day-to-day development; ability to apply AI effectively (prompting strategies, code/test generation, agentic workflows).
  • Clear communication, ownership mindset, and a bias toward shipping.

Nice to have

  • Encore experience specifically.
  • Web scraping and crawling at scale: rate limiting, proxies, anti-bot handling, content extraction.
  • Building products on LLM APIs: structured outputs, evaluation, prompt versioning, cost/latency tuning, MCP servers.
  • LLM observability and evaluation tooling (LangWatch, Arize Phoenix, or similar).
  • Observability stacks (Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry).
  • Analytics tooling (PostHog, ClickHouse).
  • Docker and cloud deployment (Railway, AWS, GCP); Infrastructure as Code basics.
  • Security best practices (OWASP, OAuth2/JWT, secrets management, GDPR-aware data handling).
  • Experience with email/CRM integrations (IMAP, Gmail API, Microsoft Graph, HubSpot/Zoho).
  • Familiarity with the M&A, private equity, or B2B data space.

Our stack

  • Backend: Python microservices, Encore (TypeScript/Node.js) services
  • Orchestration & messaging: Prefect, NSQ, background job queues, n8n
  • Data: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse (analytics)
  • Infrastructure: Railway, Docker, GitHub Actions
  • Observability: Grafana, Tempo, LangWatch, Arize Phoenix (LLM tracing & evaluation)
  • Analytics & tooling: PostHog, Linear, internal skills/MCP system
  • AI: LLM-assisted development workflows, LLM APIs in production, MCP integrations

Benefits

  • Meaningful ownership of core systems in a small, senior team
  • Direct impact on a product used by PE firms and M&A professionals
  • Support for AI-enhanced workflows and tooling
  • Budget for learning, conferences, and hardware
  • Flexible hours and remote-friendly culture

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build the platform that catches data problems before they become business problems.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll join our Platform team and own the full path from backend service to production: the Java services that power Soda Cloud and the AWS/Kubernetes infrastructure they run on. To be clear about the shape of this role: you're a backend engineer first. Most of your time goes into designing and building services. Infrastructure is the part of your craft that lets you own them all the way to production, not a separate job. This is not a DevOps or SRE position. You ship features, and you make sure the platform underneath them scales to billions of datasets.

We're product engineers, not ticket-takers: you'll talk to users, shape solutions with your PM, and ship end-to-end. No hand-offs, no waiting. We also build agentically: AI coding agents are part of how the whole team ships, and the platform you own is a big part of what makes them effective.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build robust backend services and APIs in Java for a multi-tenant SaaS platform. This is where most of your time goes.
  • Ship product features end-to-end and work directly with product and customers on what to build. Your opinion matters here.
  • Improve the reliability, performance, and scalability of the services you own, and carry them all the way to production on our AWS/Kubernetes platform.
  • Keep the team shipping fast: CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, observability. This is the platform work that multiplies everyone else.
  • Improve the systems that make agentic development work: fast CI feedback, reliable dev environments, and the guardrails that let agents ship safely.
  • Drive architectural decisions, from service design to how the platform underneath should evolve.

Hiring Process

  1. CV screen
  2. 20-minute phone screen
  3. First technical interview (45 min)
  4. Second technical interview (60 min)
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

You Should Have

  • 5+ years building backend software at a product company: you've designed, built, and owned real production services, not just operated them.
  • Strong Java: APIs, async processing, concurrency, performance tuning.
  • Solid SQL in a backend context: schema design, query optimization, migrations in production. We run MySQL and ClickHouse.
  • Architectural judgment: you understand how API and service design choices shape data flow, query patterns, latency, and failure modes at runtime.
  • You run what you build: your services have lived on Kubernetes and AWS (EKS, IAM, networking, RDS, S3) in production, and you're happy owning that layer for the team.
  • CI/CD, GitOps, and infrastructure-as-code: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD/Flux, Terraform or Pulumi, plus solid scripting.
  • Observability as a habit: metrics, logging, tracing (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), and you actually write tests.
  • Agentic engineering: you ship production code with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) in the loop, and you know how to direct them well while keeping the quality bar high.
  • Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries.
  • Fluent English.

Good to Have

  • Multi-tenant SaaS at scale; high-growth startup experience.
  • Python: our data engineering stack runs on it.
  • Regulated-environment experience (ISO27001, SOC2).
  • Experience building agentic workflows into the product: LLM-powered features, tool-using agents, or AI-driven automation shipped to real users.
  • Data quality, data management, data observability, or ML monitoring industry experience.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation €85,000-120,000/year + equity.
  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • A team of senior engineers who ship, across 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.
  • International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.

title: Security Engineer III - Security Operations
description:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Primer is looking for a Security Engineer to help us detect, investigate, and respond to threats across our cloud infrastructure. You'll take ownership of a meaningful slice of our detection and response capability — tuning what our SIEM catches, building the automation that speeds up how we react, and being a first responder when something looks wrong.


What you'll be doing

  • Plan and deliver detection and response work end-to-end — from a new detection rule to a fully automated response — within your area of ownership.

  • Build, tune and maintain detections across our SIEM (Elastic) and AWS environment, closing gaps that existing coverage misses.

  • Own an investigation queue: triage, investigate, escalate and resolve security incidents, and write up findings clearly enough to stand on their own.

  • Build runbooks and automations (Python, and no-code tools like Zapier or Tines) to cut manual work out of triage and response.

  • Make and document risk decisions in your area, and know when to pull in others.

  • Support our compliance programme by keeping the controls you own audit-ready and contributing evidence for audits (e.g. SOC 2, PCI DSS).

  • Use Terraform and Python to build and maintain the infrastructure behind your detections and tooling.

  • Join our on-call rotation for incident response and monitoring.

What we're looking for

  • Hands-on experience building and tuning detections in a SIEM (Elastic preferred; Splunk, Sentinel or similar also welcome)

  • Experience with AWS and cloud-native detection and response

  • Comfortable with Python for scripting and automation

  • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code

  • Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK

  • Real experience triaging, investigating and resolving security incidents

  • Clear, structured written communication

Nice to have

  • Experience with no-code security automation / SOAR-style tooling

  • Exposure to compliance frameworks like PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO 27001

  • Background in fintech, payments or another regulated industry

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

Our benefits

🌍 We are fully remote and globally distributed; and have been since day one
💰 Competitive share options
🌴 Uncapped holiday, with 25 days minimum to be taken
🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities
📅 Workations & Company Retreat

📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits (depending on location)

title: Product Designer (Experimentation) (f/m/d)
description:
Your mission

We're looking for a designer who decides with evidence. Most design roles stop at the handover. This one does not. You will design a part of the product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and read the results yourself. If you have ever shipped a redesign and never really found out whether it worked, this is the opposite of that.

You will sit inside one product delivery leadership team, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it – not off to one side taking requests. And you will not be doing it alone: you join a group of Product Designers across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.

English is our working language. German matters here too: you will be designing flows that German-speaking neighbours read.

Concretely, you will:

  • Design experiences that fit how people already live. Our product mirrors real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that feel natural to someone standing on their doorstep with one hand on their phone, not to add features because we can.

  • Frame the real problem before solving it. Take a vague ask, find the actual question underneath it, and make it explainable. A well framed problem to solve is half the battle.

  • Run the experiment, and read it honestly. Design a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome with our data team. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, which is most of them, and saying what you would do differently.

  • Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.

  • Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do. Polish goes where it changes behaviour, not onto every surface.

  • Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less.


Your profile

  • You practice design, and you are very comfortable with numbers. You might come from an analyst background and bring a love of design and design thinking, or vice versa.

  • You have technical know-how. You need to be able to construct the pipelines and dashboards yourself, use our experimentation platform, and our design system tooling.

  • You get your own numbers. Whether through SQL, AI-assisted querying, or both, you do not wait for someone else to pull data for you. 

  • You have run experiments end to end. Hypothesis, design, instrumentation, analysis, decision. Not just handing a mockup to someone who tested it later.

  • You care about craft and are attentive to details. You can tell the difference between good enough and actually good and you design experiences people do not have to think about.

  • You use AI as a tool already or want to. This role allows you to have more control and impact through both design and analysis, but to do this well you'll need to leverage (and at times extend) our AI enablement stack.

  • You present your work clearly, defend your decisions when challenged, and are comfortable in front of a crowd.

  • Excellent English skills for working in our international team.

To apply, share a portfolio that shows your work by impact — at least one project walked through end to end: the hypothesis, what you designed, the result, and what you took from it. Show us how you used data to move your thinking forward, and where experimentation shaped what you built. 

Nice to have

  • Experience with a marketplace, community, classifieds, or other network product. 

  • Strong German, or the confidence to design in it with support.

  • Experience building or maintaining parts of a design system. 

  • Comfortable writing SQL without AI assistance.


What we offer

  • Hybrid work model combining office and remote days 

  • A meaningful job – we're creating a great product with real added value for the community

  • Work in a cheerful and experienced team that exchanges ideas and learns from each other

  • Insights into the entire work process of our social startup and the nebenan.de foundation

  • Responsibility and great opportunities to actively contribute

  • Your nebenan.de SpenditCard – you'll receive an additional income of 35 Euros per month, which you can use for things of your choice

  • 30 days of vacation per year – we also offer the possibility of workation models and a sabbatical

  • A workplace in Berlin-Kreuzberg and regular events like yoga or Lunch & Learn sessions.


If we’ve captured your interest, apply now and let us know why you’re the perfect fit for the job!

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
About Payflows

At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it.

But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool.

We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤

Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter.

That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform, where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control.

We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized.

We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters.

In 2024, investors trusted us with a $25M Series A. That gives us the chance to keep growing while also strengthening our foundations and building the system that will power this agent-driven future.

Today, we’re about 35 people from many different countries, and we’re looking for a few amazing humans to join the next chapter. 🤗

🚀 What you’ll actually do

You’ll help build a product that real finance teams rely on every day.

For us, engineering is not just about clean code, it’s about reliability, clarity, and trust, especially when money and automation are involved.

In a typical week, you might:

  • Design and implement new services for a product feature.

  • Refactor an early service to make it more robust.

  • Investigate a performance or production issue.

  • Work with product and frontend to shape a new feature.

  • Review code and help teammates improve.

  • Build backend tools that our AI agents use to perform real finance operations.

  • Design safe, deterministic workflows where agents propose actions and humans review them.

Your time will be split between building new features and improving what already exists. Both matter.

You won’t just build endpoints. You’ll help shape the execution layer that our agents rely on: the APIs, data models, and workflows that let them act safely in production.

You’ll work closely with product, frontend, and customer-facing teams. We expect engineers to take ownership of parts of the system and help make them more reliable over time.

💻 Our current tech reality

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools 🙏

Python is our core language. It helps us move fast, keep the code readable, and fits naturally with our AI-driven approach. A growing part of the system is built around agents that use our backend as a set of reliable, deterministic tools.

  • Core language: Python

  • Backend: FastAPI + Pydantic

  • Data: PostgreSQL

  • Infra: AWS, serverless when it makes sense

  • Performance: some Rust for critical paths

  • Architecture: multi-service backend, simple enough to reason about

Some parts of the system are clean and well-tested. Others were built quickly and need love. That’s the phase we’re in.

Over the next year, we’ll focus on:

  • Turning core workflows into reliable tools for our agents

  • Simplifying services

  • Improving tests and observability

  • Making performance more predictable

  • Cleaning up early code

We know we’re not perfect, but we care a lot about improving step by step.


✨ Who’s going to thrive with us

You’ll probably feel comfortable here if:

  • You like building products people actually use.

  • You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship.

  • You take initiative and lead by example.

  • You’re curious and enjoy figuring things out.

  • You’re pragmatic about trade-offs.

  • You communicate with kindness and clarity.

This role is a great fit if you’re excited by the idea of:

  • Building systems that are used by AI agents, not just humans.

  • Designing reliable, safe automation in production.

  • Working on a product that is still early and evolving quickly.

You don’t need to know everything about AI. But you should be curious about it and excited to work in a system where agents are part of the core product 🤖

🧩 What you’ll get from this role

  • Real ownership over parts of the system.

  • Direct impact on customers and product decisions.

  • A small, human team where your work is visible and meaningful 🤝

  • A mix of feature work, system design, and technical improvements.

  • Exposure to real scaling and production challenges.

  • The chance to help build an agent-driven product from the inside.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • Flexible remote setup (we only ask you to be at the office the first 3 days of each month).

  • A high-autonomy environment where you have real ownership and space to make an impact.

  • Plenty of room to grow, take responsibility, and shape parts of the product.

  • A culture based on trust, ownership, and clear communication.

This isn’t a huge corporate environment. In exchange, you get autonomy, responsibility, and the chance to shape a product that’s still early in its story—and help build what finance operations will look like in the next decade 🚀

Ihre Aufgaben

Um unser Business weiter auszubauen, suchen wir engagierte Kolleg*innen – diesmal für eine Rolle, die es bei uns so noch nie gab.
Rund um KI und Automatisierung haben wir schon einiges angestoßen – und suchen dich, um diese Schritte spürbar zu beschleunigen. Statt Tool-Wildwuchs entwickeln wir eigene integrierte Systeme auf Basis von KI und Automatisierung für Vertrieb und Operations. Daneben wachsen KI-Assistenten, automatisierte Auswertungen aus Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn und unseren SEO-Tools sowie Reportings, die sich selbst schreiben und über Human in the Loop besser werden. Ein großer Teil der Kundenarbeit unserer über 60 Kolleg*innen ist und bleibt trotzdem Handarbeit.
Du liest eine API-Dokumentation und hast zwei Stunden später einen laufenden Prototyp? Du verstehst, warum eine SEA-Managerin anders auf Daten schaut als ein SEO – und kannst einem Kollegen ohne technischen Hintergrund erklären, wie er das Ergebnis ab morgen selbst bedient? Du denkst KI nicht als Spielerei, sondern als System, das dokumentiert, datenschutzkonform und im Betrieb stabil sein muss? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.
Zum Ausbau unseres AI- und Automatisierungsbereichs suchen wir dich als AI Automation Engineer – Marketing & Operations Consulting (m/w/d).
Du entwickelst und betreibst die KI- und Automatisierungssysteme, mit denen unsere Teams täglich arbeiten – und bringst dieselbe Kompetenz in unsere Kundenprojekte ein, von Marketing-Technology-Fragen bis zur Beratung rund um Automatisierung. Deine Arbeitsweise ist AI Engineering gepaart mit Vibe Coding: Du weißt, wie man ein System sauber aufsetzt, betreibt und absichert – und du kommst trotzdem in Tagen statt Quartalen zum lauffähigen Ergebnis, weil du KI als Werkzeug beim Bauen selbstverständlich einsetzt. Du verbindest Werkzeuge miteinander, schaffst die Datengrundlage, auf der diese Systeme überhaupt erst sinnvoll arbeiten, und befähigst Kolleg*innen wie Kund*innen, damit zu arbeiten. So werden aus Möglichkeiten messbar eingesparte Stunden.
Infos unter www.klickpiloten.de.
 
Deine Aufgaben

  • Bauen und betreiben: Du entwickelst unsere internen KI-Systeme weiter – Assistenten, Agenten, automatisierte Workflows – vom ersten Prototyp bis in den produktiven Betrieb. Du baust selbst, mit Claude Code, Cursor oder womit auch immer du am schnellsten zum Ergebnis kommst. Und du hältst am Leben, was du gebaut hast: Monitoring, Fehlerfälle, Kosten, Qualität der Ergebnisse. Schnell gebaut heißt bei uns nicht wegwerfbar.
  • Systeme verbinden, Kontext schaffen: Du verdrahtest unsere Werkzeuge miteinander – Google Ads API, Meta Marketing API, SEO-Tools, unser CRM, Google Workspace, MCP-Server. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere KI-Systeme mit den richtigen Daten arbeiten. Das ist der eigentliche Hebel: Ein Modell ist nur so gut wie der Kontext, den es bekommt.
  • Kundenprojekte und Marketing Technology: Du berätst unsere Kund*innen zu ihrem Marketing-Technology-Stack: welche Systeme sie wirklich brauchen, wie Shop, CRM und Werbeplattformen zusammenspielen, wo Datenfeeds und Schnittstellen hingehören. Du konzipierst kundenspezifische Automatisierungen und KI-Anwendungsfälle und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unseren Fachteams um – von der Machbarkeitsfrage im Pitch bis zur Lösung, die beim Kunden läuft.
  • Consulting rund um Marketing und Automatisierung: Du führst Workshops bei Kund*innen durch, findest heraus, wo in deren Prozessen Zeit und Datenqualität verloren gehen, und übersetzt das in konkrete Maßnahmen. Was sich bei uns intern bewährt, entwickelst du zu einem Beratungsangebot weiter, das wir verkaufen können.
  • Tracking, Consent und Analytics: Du baust Tracking- und Analytics-Setups auf, bringst das Consent Management sauber dazu und konsolidierst vor allem Marketingdaten aus ihren vielen Quellen – Werbeplattformen, SEO-Tools, Shop, CRM – zu einem Bild, das trägt. Du automatisierst, was daraus regelmäßig entstehen muss: die Präsentation, die sich aus Kampagnendaten selbst zusammenbaut, das Reporting, das Dienstagfrüh fertig im Sheet steht. Und du bleibst nicht bei der Zahl stehen, sondern liest aus den Daten, was sie über Kampagnen, Zielgruppen und Budgets sagen, und machst daraus eine Empfehlung, mit der Teams und Kund*innen etwas anfangen können.
  • Qualitätschecks und Audits automatisieren: Du automatisierst unsere internen Qualitätssicherungen – Kampagnen-, Tracking- und Account-Setups werden regelmäßig maschinell geprüft, statt dass jemand Checklisten abarbeitet. Abweichungen fallen auf, bevor eine Kundin sie bemerkt. Aus wiederkehrenden Fehlerbildern machst du Regeln, die dauerhaft mitlaufen.
  • Enablement und Coaching: Du schulst und begleitest die Teams, fortlaufend und nah an der konkreten Arbeit statt im einmaligen Workshop. Du schreibst Playbooks, Anleitungen und Dokumentation, die auch jemand versteht, der nicht dabei war. Und du erkennst, welche Handarbeit sich zu automatisieren lohnt und welche man besser Handarbeit sein lässt.
  • Compliance, Datenschutz und Vertraulichkeit: Du entscheidest mit, welche KI-Anbieter und Modelle wir einsetzen und wo Kundendaten dabei landen dürfen. DSGVO, EU AI Act und unsere Vertraulichkeitszusagen bringst du in eine Form, mit der das Team im Alltag arbeiten kann. Du dokumentierst unsere Systeme so, dass sie prüfbar und übergabefähig bleiben.
  • Schnittstelle nach außen: Wo wir nicht selbst bauen, steuerst du externe Entwickler*innen, Dienstleister und Tool-Anbieter – von der Anforderung über die Abnahme bis zum Betrieb. Auch auf Kundenseite bist du die Person, die mit IT-Abteilungen und Technikpartnern auf Augenhöhe spricht und zwischen Marketing-Anforderung und technischer Umsetzung übersetzt.
  • Innovation: Du beobachtest, was sich bei Modellen, Agenten-Frameworks und Marketing-APIs bewegt, bewertest neue Features nüchtern und entscheidest, was davon bei uns Produktivbetrieb verdient – und was nicht.
Was diese Stelle nicht ist
Damit wir uns gegenseitig keine Zeit nehmen:
  • Keine reine Beratungsrolle. Du berätst Kund*innen, aber du baust jede Woche auch selbst.
  • Kein klassischer Entwicklerjob. Du sitzt nicht im abgeschirmten Sprint, sondern zwischen Fachteams und Kund*innen.
  • Kein Prompt-Engineering-Job. Prompts sind ein Werkzeug, nicht das Produkt.


Anforderungen

Dein Profil

  • Du hast in den letzten Jahren Automatisierungen oder KI-Anwendungen gebaut, die produktiv im Einsatz waren. Zeig uns zwei oder drei davon.
  • Du arbeitest mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung, Stichwort Vibe Coding – und kannst gleichzeitig beurteilen, was dabei herauskommt: TypeScript oder Python, REST-APIs, OAuth, Git, Datenbanken. Du musst keine Software-Architektin sein, aber ein Stacktrace darf dich nicht abschrecken und generierter Code geht bei dir nicht ungeprüft in Produktion.
  • Praxis mit LLM-APIs: Tool Use, strukturierte Ausgaben, Embeddings, das Bewerten von Ergebnisqualität und ein Gefühl für Token-Kosten.
  • Digitalmarketing-Verständnis. Du weißt, was eine Kampagnenstruktur ist, was ein Sichtbarkeitsindex aussagt und warum Attribution kompliziert ist.
  • Sicherheit in Web Analytics: Du kannst ein sauberes, einwilligungskonformes Tracking-Setup aufbauen, Datenquellen zusammenführen und aus dem Ergebnis eine Empfehlung ableiten – nicht nur ein Dashboard bauen.
  • Erfahrung mit Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n, Make oder Zapier – und ein Urteil darüber, wann man sie einsetzt und wann man besser selbst baut.
  • Du bist gern vor Kund*innen: Du kannst eine technische Lösung so präsentieren, dass auch die Marketingleitung versteht, was sie davon hat, und sagst auch mal ab, wenn eine Idee sich nicht rechnet.
  • Du kannst erklären: verständlich, geduldig, ohne Fachjargon, wo er nicht nötig ist.
  • Du dokumentierst, ohne dass man dich darum bitten muss.
  • Deutsch als Muttersprache und sicheres Englisch für jede Dokumentation.
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Terminen bei Kund*innen und an unseren anderen Standorten.
Ob du das auf Mid- oder Senior-Level machst, klären wir gemeinsam. Uns interessiert, was du gebaut hast, nicht wie lange du dabei bist.

Nice to have
  • Praxis mit der Google Ads API oder der Meta Marketing API.
  • Erfahrung mit MCP-Servern oder eigenen Agenten-Setups.
  • Google Apps Script, Slides API, Sheets API.
  • Erfahrung mit SEO-Tools wie Sistrix, Semrush oder DataForSEO.
  • Analytics-Stack: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Server-Side Tagging, BigQuery, Looker Studio.
  • Weitere Marketing-Technology-Erfahrung: Consent-Management-Plattformen wie Usercentrics oder Cookiebot, CDPs oder Marketing-Automation-Systeme.
  • Agenturhintergrund, damit dich Kundenprojekt-Realität nicht überrascht.
  • Berührung mit DSGVO-Themen, Auftragsverarbeitung oder IT-Sicherheit.
Wir bieten
  • Eine neu geschaffene Rolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung
  • Ein Budget für Tools und Modelle, das zu dieser Arbeit passt, plus Zeit zum Ausprobieren

  • Großartiger Teamspirit, kollegiale Atmosphäre, flache Hierarchien
  • Spannende Projekte mit bekannten Marken aus E-Commerce, Industrie und Consumer Brands
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice/Remote-Optionen
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Deutschland-Ticket-Zuschuss, Firmenrabatt und Zuschuss zur Urban Sports Club/Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft
  • Moderner zentraler Arbeitsplatz in Stuttgart, Hamburg oder Berlin

title: Account Executive
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in United Kingdom.

This is a highly technical sales role focused on helping engineering teams adopt infrastructure and developer-focused technology.
You will own opportunities from initial engagement through close, working directly with technically sophisticated customers who expect credibility and speed.
The role combines consultative selling, technical problem-solving, proof-of-concept management, and disciplined pipeline ownership.
You will work closely with Solutions Engineers while becoming a trusted presence in customer communication channels and helping remove obstacles to purchase.
Success requires the confidence to explain complex concepts simply, challenge assumptions, and be transparent when a solution is not the right fit.
You will operate with significant autonomy in a fast-moving environment where experimentation, urgency, and customer outcomes matter.
This is an opportunity for either an experienced technical AE or a technically minded professional ready to take ownership of a sales quota.


Accountabilities
  • Own the sales process from qualified opportunity through successful close, with a strong focus on helping technical customers achieve their desired outcomes.
  • Build trusted relationships with engineers and technical stakeholders, including actively participating in customer communication channels such as Slack.
  • Manage and close inbound sales opportunities, moving prospects efficiently through the buying process.
  • Lead and coordinate proof-of-concept initiatives in partnership with Solutions Engineers, ensuring technical and commercial objectives are clearly defined.
  • Help customers troubleshoot questions and remove technical or commercial obstacles that could prevent a successful purchase.
  • Communicate honestly and transparently, including clearly explaining when a solution is not an appropriate fit.
  • Maintain a systematic approach to pipeline management, ensuring opportunities, next steps, and follow-ups are consistently tracked.
  • Navigate, improve, and contribute to internal sales and go-to-market systems and processes.
  • Experiment with new approaches to prospect engagement, deal execution, and GTM workflows, using results and customer feedback to continuously improve.
  • Move quickly and independently, identifying what needs to be done and taking action without requiring detailed direction.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience as an Account Executive, particularly in a technical B2B, SaaS, infrastructure, or developer-focused sales environment; alternatively, strong technical experience combined with readiness to take on a sales quota.
    • Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to comfortably understand API documentation, technical product concepts, and engineering workflows.
    • Experience selling to developers or engineering teams is highly desirable, with an understanding of how to build credibility with technically sophisticated buyers.
    • Strong organizational and pipeline-management skills, with a systematic approach to tracking opportunities and following through on commitments.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.
    • High integrity and customer orientation, with a commitment to honest communication rather than overselling.
    • Strong sense of urgency and ability to operate at the pace of technically sophisticated, fast-moving customers.
    • Self-directed and resourceful, with the ability to take ownership and make progress without extensive supervision.
    • Curious and experimental mindset, with a willingness to test new approaches, learn from unsuccessful experiments, and adapt quickly.
    • Experience with databases, search technologies, or infrastructure software is a plus.
    • Familiarity with GTM automation tools such as Clay or n8n is advantageous.
    • Comfort working with Python, JavaScript, Linux, or major cloud platforms is a plus.
    • Willingness to prioritize correctness, customer evidence, initiative, and continuous improvement in day-to-day decision-making.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote working environment.
      • Opportunity to work from Canada, the United States, or Europe.
      • Significant autonomy and ownership over your work.
      • Direct exposure to highly technical customers and engineering teams.
      • Opportunity to work closely with Solutions Engineers and technical stakeholders.
      • Chance to develop expertise across databases, search, infrastructure, and developer-focused technology.
      • Fast-moving environment that encourages experimentation and learning from results.
      • Opportunity to influence and improve internal go-to-market systems and processes.
      • Role with direct commercial impact and responsibility for closing meaningful technical deals.

title: Accounting Solutions Consultant
description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

This huge market is ours to take. We’ve raised $200M+ from Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

We are building industry-defining accounting and finance software. We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Accounting Solutions Consultant to join our team and help lead the successful onboarding of new customers onto Rillet.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong accounting foundation who is excited to work directly with customers and help finance teams modernize how they operate. You may come from Big 4 audit, accounting advisory, finance transformation, or an operational accounting role at a high-growth technology company. You do not need to have formally led ERP implementations before, but you do need to be systems-minded, highly organized, customer-oriented, and eager to learn quickly in a fast-paced startup environment.

We’re primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States. Our hybrid schedule brings office-based team members together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week. Some roles may spend more time in the office depending on the needs of the team.

What You'll Do

  • Lead key parts of customer onboarding and deployment, helping ensure a smooth and timely implementation experience

  • Partner with internal teams across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to execute implementation plans and solve customer problems quickly

  • Learn and analyze client accounting and finance workflows, then translate those needs into clear requirements and practical solutions

  • Guide customers through onboarding, training, change management, and adoption

  • Support data migration, reconciliations, systems setup, and integration coordination

  • Track milestones, drive follow-through, and keep internal and external stakeholders aligned throughout the onboarding process

  • Identify risks early, escalate issues quickly, and help keep customer launches on track

  • Build trust with customers by being responsive, thoughtful, and solutions-oriented

  • Maintain clear documentation and provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders

Who We're Looking For

  • 4-7 years of experience in accounting, audit, advisory, or related customer-facing roles

  • Strong accounting foundation, with the ability to speak credibly about close, reconciliations, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and core finance workflows

  • Excellent communication skills and the presence to work directly with customers and senior stakeholders

  • Systems-minded and excited to learn implementation work, even if you have not formally held an implementation title before

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams at once

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high attention to detail

  • Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams

  • Experience in Big 4, SaaS or at a technology company is a plus

The expected base salary range for this role varies by location:

Tier A: $100,000 – $150,000

Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. You can view Rillet’s compensation zones here.

Final compensation within the applicable range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

 

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

Compensation: $100K – $150K • Offers Equity

  • Zone A • $100K – $150K • Offers Equity

  • Outbound Mindset: You have a desire, even an obsession, to identify new prospects, contacts and decision makers to expand the number of new logos

Moreover, we are looking for someone based in Paris (to meet prospects, go on events and be close to your management) but working remotely anywhere in France is permitted.

title: Chief of Staff / Business Ops
description:
Global supply chains move 80% of world trade and almost none of it accounts for its climate impact. Searoutes builds the data infrastructure that lets freight forwarders, shippers, and carriers measure and cut their CO2 footprint. We're a ~20-person SaaS team headquartered between Marseille and Nice, backed by Breakthrough (a US venture platform), and growing fast with enterprise logistics clients across the globe.

We're looking for a Chief of Staff to become the CEO's right hand and the operational engine of the company as we scale, someone who thrives on turning strategic priorities into flawless execution, and who wants a front-row seat (and real influence) on how a European climate-tech scale-up is built.

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

  • Direct line to the top. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the CEO and sit in the room for every major decision, no layers, no filters.
  • Real scope, real ownership. This isn't a coordination-only or admin-only role. You'll own the board rhythm, shape internal reporting, and run special projects end-to-end.
  • A bridge between two worlds. You'll be the connective tissue between a lean European startup and a US shareholder, a rare vantage point most operators only get years into their career.
  • Impact you can see. With ~20 people, your work doesn't get lost in a hierarchy. What you fix, ships. What you build, gets used.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Board & shareholder rhythm Own the full cadence with our shareholders:  board decks, pre-reads, action tracking, and follow-through, so nothing slips between meetings
  • Leadership operating system Run the agenda, follow-ups, and accountability loop for leadership meetings. The person who makes sure decisions turn into action, not just notes.
  • Reporting & analytics Build and maintain pipeline dashboards (HubSpot), KPI tracking, and management/investor reporting that leadership actually relies on.
  • CEO partnership Support the CEO on communications, meeting prep, and represent them in operational forums when needed.
  • Special projects Lead cross-functional initiative:  process improvements, tool rollouts, scaling projects with real autonomy to design and execute.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years in business operations, strategy consulting, or a Chief of Staff–type role, SaaS or logistics/supply chain experience is a strong plus
  • A builder's mindset: organized, detail-obsessed, and allergic to dropped balls
  • Comfort with data: HubSpot, spreadsheets, dashboards, and slide decks are your natural habitat
  • Fluent French and English, written and spoken
  • Genuine ease working across cultures, you'll be in daily contact with US-based teams
  • A proactive streak: you spot what's needed before anyone has to ask
  • Startup energy,  you're energized by ambiguity, not slowed by it

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience working with US shareholders or inside a subsidiary structure
  • Familiarity with Notion, PandaDoc, Basecamp, or HubSpot
  • A genuine interest in sustainability, logistics, or the maritime industry
  • Experience helping a company professionalize through a scaling phase

Benefits

  • A high-impact seat at the leadership table, from day one
  • Exposure to both European startup culture and US corporate governance
  • A fast-paced, no-BS environment; your work matters immediately, not eventually
  • Competitive fixed salary + performance bonus
  • Mutuelle, and standard French benefits (Syntec collective agreement)
  • Two company-wide offsites a year
  • A mission worth showing up for: helping decarbonize global trade

title: Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d) | Fullstack für KI-Produkte
description:
Über uns

Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Architektur & Umsetzung Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt. 
  • KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen. 
  • Full-Stack liefern Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche.
  • Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit. 
  • Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft.
  • Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind. 
  • AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen.
  • Team & Produkt weiterbringen Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter. 


Das bringst Du mit

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme, idealerweise im KI- bzw. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld
  • Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS 
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices, API-Design, Skalierung

  • AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), kennst ihre Grenzen und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm zu vertrauen 
  • Du bist nah am Puls der Entwicklung: Du probierst neue Tools, Modelle und Workflows aktiv aus und bringst die guten ins Team - Erfahrung mit agentischen Setups (z. B. Coding-Agents in der Cloud, MCP-Integrationen, automatisierte Reviews) ist ein starkes Plus 
  • Tieferes Verständnis moderner AI-/LLM-Konzepte wie RAG, Function Calling, Embeddings oder Agenten
  • Clean Code, Testing und Code Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich und du bringst Junior Developers durch Reviews und Mentoring gern fachlich weiter

  • Erfahrung mit DSGVO, ISO 27001 oder dem EU AI Act sind ein Plus 

Was uns wichtig ist

Was uns viel wichtiger ist: Verantwortung übernehmen, das Produkt mitdenken, Anforderungen konstruktiv hinterfragen und technische Entscheidungen treffen, die man auch in zwei Jahren noch begründen kann - pragmatisch abgewogen zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit.   • Du entscheidest ob Hansefit-Mitgliedschaft oder 50 € monatlich per Spendit Card - dein Benefit, deine Wahl.

  • Ein Team, das wirklich zählt. Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen und ein offenes Ohr auch für das, was dich persönlich bewegt.


Das sind WIR

Transformation ist für uns kein Trend, sondern unser Auftrag: Seit 1995 begleitet die avenit Group Unternehmen dabei, sich für die digitale Zukunft neu aufzustellen - ganzheitlich, strategisch und mit klarem Blick für nachhaltige Erfolge. Wir glauben daran, dass nachhaltiger Erfolg auf Augenhöhe entsteht; im echten Dialog mit unseren Kunden. Unsere 60 Kolleg:innen lassen diese Vision jeden Tag zur Realität werden. Werde Teil eines Teams, das Zukunft nicht nur denkt, sondern gestaltet.
